```plato

    // The same quad split along the diagonal that matches a positive twist,
    // giving the snub's two edge-triangles.
    // Precondition: `corner` is canonical.
    SnubFacesOfEdge(self: PolygonMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): Array<Array<VertexIndex>>
    {
        var twin = self.TwinCorner(corner);
        return [[VertexIndex(self.NextCorner(corner).Value),
                 VertexIndex(corner.Value),
                 VertexIndex(twin.Value)],
                [VertexIndex(corner.Value),
                 VertexIndex(self.NextCorner(twin).Value),
                 VertexIndex(twin.Value)]];
    }
```
